title: Registry incident #1: a harvest's 29-minute-old snapshot erased a supervisory quarantine
symptom: A quarantine and a licence backfill written at 02:56 were gone at 03:11; the two off-goal datasets were back at status downloaded.
root_cause: The documented residual of the v3.1.0 fix: _save_registry still whole-wrote the snapshot it had loaded at job start, under the lock but without re-reading.
correction_made: _save_registry merge-writes: under the lock it re-reads the current registry and grafts only its own slugs; the quarantine block and provenance.license are never resurrected over by a stale copy.
